## Project Overview


### 0. Configure environment. Load data.
```{r config, show=F, warning=F, message=F}

source(here::here("analysis/0-config.R"))

############################
# Wide event data
############################
df_violence <- read_rds(paste0(temp_data_path,"df_violence.rds"))
df_all <- readRDS(paste0(final_data_path,"df_01B_all.rds"))
df_mal <- readRDS(paste0(final_data_path,"df_01B_mal.rds"))
df_pne <- readRDS(paste0(final_data_path,"df_01B_pne.rds"))
df_dia <- readRDS(paste0(final_data_path,"df_01B_dia.rds"))

############################
# CSPS lat + lon
############################
csps_gps <- read_csv(paste0(temp_data_path,"csps_gps.csv"))

############################
# File 01B (final) data
############################
df_all <- readRDS(paste0(final_data_path,"df_01B_all.rds"))

```


### Prepare data. Summary tables for plotting.
```{r aggregate-data}
############################
# Quick stat: total events
# by year
############################
df_violence %>%
  filter(year %in% 2020:2022) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(n_events=n())

############################
# Quick stat: total visits
# by CSPS (2020 - 2022)
############################
gps_03B_visits <- #df_total
  df_all %>%
  group_by(csps) %>%
  summarise(n_visit=sum(n_visit, na.rm=T)) %>%
  left_join(csps_gps)

gps_03B_visits_yr <- #df_by_year
  df_all %>%
  group_by(csps, visit_year) %>%
  mutate(visit_year = as.factor(visit_year)) %>%
  summarise(n_visit=sum(n_visit, na.rm=T)) %>%
  left_join(csps_gps)

```


### Make Shapefiles.
```{r make-shp}
##############################################
# Load admin boundaries from HDX
# (Humanitarian Data eXchange)
# https://data.humdata.org/dataset/geoboundaries-admin-boundaries-for-burkina-faso
# manuscript DOI: https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0231866
##############################################
shp_03B_adm0 <- 
  st_read(dsn = paste0(raw_data_path, "geoBoundaries-BFA-ADM0-all/geoBoundaries-BFA-ADM0.shp"))  # country

shp_03B_adm1 <- 
  st_read(dsn = paste0(raw_data_path, "geoBoundaries-BFA-ADM1-all/geoBoundaries-BFA-ADM1.shp"))  # region

shp_03B_adm2 <- 
  st_read(dsn = paste0(raw_data_path, "geoBoundaries-BFA-ADM2-all/geoBoundaries-BFA-ADM2.shp"))  # province

shp_03B_adm3 <- 
  st_read(dsn = paste0(raw_data_path, "geoBoundaries-BFA-ADM3-all/geoBoundaries-BFA-ADM3.shp"))  # commune

############################
# Create Kossi shp file
############################
shp_03B_kossi <- #bfa_shape
  bfa_adm2 %>% 
  dplyr::filter(grepl("Kossi",shapeName))

############################
# Create event data shp file
############################
# Overall (2020-2022)
shp_03B_events <- #viol_pts
  df_violence %>% 
  mutate(year_fac = as.factor(year)) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), 
           crs = "EPSG:4326")

# 2020
shp_03B_events_2020 <- # viol_pts_2020
  shp_03B_events %>% 
  dplyr::filter(year==2020)

# 2021
shp_03B_events_2021 <- # viol_pts_2021
  shp_03B_events %>% 
  dplyr::filter(year==2021)

# 2022
shp_03B_events_2022 <- # viol_pts_2022
  shp_03B_events %>% 
  dplyr::filter(year==2022)

############################
# Create CSPS visits shp file
# (adjusted to per 1000)
############################
# Overall (2020-2022)
shp_03B_csps <- # csps_pts
  gps_03B_visits %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("csps_lon", "csps_lat"), 
           crs = "EPSG:4326")

#CSPS visits per 1000 points (by year)
shp_03B_csps_2020 <- # csps_pts_2020
  gps_03B_visits_yr %>% 
  dplyr::filter(visit_year == 2020) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("csps_lon", "csps_lat"), 
           crs = "EPSG:4326")

shp_03B_csps_2021 <- # csps_pts_2021
  gps_03B_visits_yr %>% 
  dplyr::filter(visit_year == 2021) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("csps_lon", "csps_lat"), 
           crs = "EPSG:4326")

shp_03B_csps_2022 <- # csps_pts_2022
  gps_03B_visits_yr %>% 
  dplyr::filter(visit_year == 2022) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("csps_lon", "csps_lat"), 
           crs = "EPSG:4326")

```


### 3. Create maps.
```{r make-maps-figs, warning=F}
############################
# Define panel labels
############################
map_labels <- c("A","B","C","D")

map_labels_long <- c("A. 2020-2022, n=153 events",
                 "B. 2020, n=26 events",
                 "C. 2021, n=42 events",
                 "D. 2022, n=85 events")

############################
# Create map panels
# (See 0-functions.R for
# helper function details.)
############################
# 2020
map_03B_2020 <- 
  bfa_map_helper(
    shp_03B_events_2020,
    shp_03B_csps_2020,
    pt_size = 1.7) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# 2021
map_03B_2021 <- 
  bfa_map_helper(
    shp_03B_events_2021, 
    shp_03B_csps_2021,
    pt_size = 1.7) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# 2022
map_03B_2022 <- 
  bfa_map_helper(
    shp_03B_events_2022, 
    shp_03B_csps_2022,
    pt_size = 1.7) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Overall (2020-2022)
map_03B_all <- # bfa_map
  bfa_map_helper(
    shp_03B_events,
    shp_03B_csps) +
  annotate("polygon", # Nouna Town icon (y=12.733333, x=-3.866667)
         x = c(-3.87, -3.85, -3.87, -3.89),
         y = c(12.75, 12.73, 12.71, 12.73),
         fill = NA, color = "#E69F00", linewidth = 1) +
    annotate("text",                       # "Nouna Town" label
             x = -3.22, y = 12.85, size = 3.2,
             label = "Nouna Town",
             fontface = "bold") +
    annotate("segment",                    # arrow from label to map
             x = -3.39, xend = -3.84,
             y = 12.83, yend = 12.73,
             arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm"), type = "closed"),
             linewidth = 0.5, 
             color = "black")

############################
# Define BFA overview map
############################
map_03B_bfa <-
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data=
              shp_03B_adm2 %>% 
              mutate(isKossi = shapeName == "Kossi"),
            aes(fill = isKossi),
            lwd=0.5) +
  coord_sf(crs = 4326) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#E69F00", 
                               "FALSE" = "#fdf6eb"),
                    guide = "none") +
  annotate("text",                       # "Kossi Province" label
           x = -4, y = 15, size = 3,
           label = "Kossi Province",
           fontface = "bold") +
  annotate("segment",                    # arrow from label to map
           x = -4.3, xend = -4,
           y = 14.8, yend = 13.65,
           arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm"), type = "closed"),
           linewidth = 0.3, 
           color = "black") + 
    theme_void()

```


```{r}
############################
# Join panels into figure
# (See 0-functions.R for
# helper function details.)
############################
fig_2_left_panel <-
  map_03B_all +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(-4.40, -3.00),   # extra room on the right
    ylim = c(12.35, 14.10),   # extra room on top
    crs = 4326
  ) +
  annotation_custom(
    grob = ggplotGrob(map_03B_bfa),
    xmin = -3.9, xmax = -3,    # longitude range for the inset
    ymin = 13.5, ymax = 14.1     # latitude range for the inset
  )

fig_2_arranged <- 
  ggarrange(fig_2_left_panel,
            ggarrange(   # col 2
              map_03B_2020, 
              map_03B_2021, 
              map_03B_2022,
              nrow = 3,
              labels = c("B. 2020 (n=26 events)",
                         "C. 2021 (n=42 events)",
                         "D. 2022 (n=85 events)")
              ),
            ncol=2,
            labels = "A."
            )

```

### Download Figure 2.
```{r download}

ggsave(paste0(figure_path,"fig_2_",Sys.Date(),".png"), 
       plot = fig_2_arranged, 
       width = 7*1.6,
       height = 6*1.6,
       units = "in")

```
